set.pl: Dickson (Andrew J. Dixon) farmstead, SW corner of 130th Ave and Delaware Pl, 2 mi NW of Palmyra (1930s Iowa aerial)
set.t: Placed from a 1930s air photo; the 1909 digs were at the smokehouse about 30 yd north of the house. About half the believed total was never found. Occupied farm: permission only.
pinev: 1930s Iowa aerial: the only farmstead 2 mi NW of Palmyra, on the SW corner of a road crossing, set back about 100 ft with a grove, matching the Des Moines Register 31 Oct 1909 description
Single source for the spot; county probate index names him Andrew J. Dixon (estate Aug 1909)
